notes: Fenn "Quickfix Bay": a cream workbench cabinet with a circuit board on the bench and two thin jointed arms that reach in from both sides; on loop (2) the arms swap poses and a solder spark flashes at one tip, then the other. A tool rack of tiny coloured handles along the bottom. Damaged: one arm snapped and dangling, the board cracked, sparks. Disabled: arms folded and dark, board dead, a tool fallen.
